decisions.reason: General interior lighting directly leverages the firm's core building-lighting knowledge, so absorptive capacity is high and withdrawal risk is minimal.
The microprismatic pendant luminaire builds on the firm's established optical and energy-efficient lighting expertise and remains a strategic flagship, making it a strong keeper.

Although marine searchlights are more distant from the core building-lighting base, they still connect to the firm's robust outdoor and industrial lighting capabilities, allowing improvement through existing R&D.
